title: Veterans Pension Care-Cost Rate Adjustment
content:
# Care-cost rate adjustment (Veterans Pension)

A care-cost rate adjustment recomputes the annual Veterans Pension from an earlier effective date when the veteran reports recurring care costs, such as an in-home aide, that he pays himself.

**Not for a forward redetermination.** A care-cost rate adjustment is not recorded for a veteran who has asked VA to redetermine his pension going forward; the care costs he reported are then taken into that redetermination.

**When it is recorded.** A proposed adjustment that lowers the rate on an income match is made only after the response period has passed since the date of the income-match notice; an adjustment that raises the rate, or one that rests on a report the veteran sent, is recorded as soon as it is computed.

**Benefit income on file.** The new annual rate is fixed only after the award carries a benefit income statement from the veteran dated on the day his VA disability compensation stopped. Put the other way, while the award carries no benefit income statement from the veteran dated on that day, the new annual rate is not yet fixed.

**Effective date, source and channel.** The adjustment takes effect on the first day of the month after the month in which the earliest reported care month began, it names as its source the report of the most recent care month, and it carries the channel through which that report reached VA.

| Item of the adjustment | Taken from |
|---|---|
| Effective date | first day of the month after the month in which the earliest reported care month began |
| Source report | the report of the most recent care month |
| Channel | the channel through which that report reached VA |
| New annual pension | whole dollars |

*Illustration (hypothetical):* care months reported for March, April and May, the earliest beginning March 1 and the May report received online — effective April 1, source the May report, channel online.

## Recording tool: `record_rate_adjustment_fee79930`

**Capability.** It records on a veteran's Veterans Pension award a rate adjustment that sets a new annual pension from a given effective date, made from a report already on the award. One call adds one rate adjustment entry naming the source report, the effective date, the new annual pension and the channel of the source report; the entry records no penalty months and no overpayment, and nothing else on the award changes.

**Invocation.** The agent unlocks `record_rate_adjustment_fee79930` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

- `pension_award_id` — the reference number of the Veterans Pension award being adjusted, as shown by the pension award lookup for this veteran.
- `source_report_id` — the reference number of the report on the award that the adjustment rests on, as shown by the pension income report lookup.
- `change_effective_date` — the date the new annual pension takes effect, written YYYY-MM-DD (calendar date, no time of day, no time zone).
- `adjusted_annual_rate` — the new annual pension in USD, whole dollars, an integer with no cents; 0 is allowed.
- `report_channel` — how the source report reached VA, copied from that report; one of `phone` (taken by telephone), `online` (submitted online), `mail` (arrived by mail) or `va_initiated` (VA itself produced it from a data match).

**Return.** On success, one sentence of the form "Rate adjustment <reference> recorded on award <award reference>: annual pension <amount> USD effective <date>, source <source reference>." Receiving this sentence means the adjustment is on the award; the new annual pension and its effective date can be read back with the adjustment's reference number. The tool defines no other outcome.
